name: Taruvi Secret Guard
description: After a credential-bearing config file is written, verify the destination is gitignored and no secret leaked into a tracked file.

then.prompt: A credential-bearing config file was just written. Verify: (1) if it contains a real Taruvi Knox API key, Context7 key, or tenant credential, that its path is gitignored and permissions are 600 — if it is tracked by git, say so immediately and tell the user to rotate the key; (2) if it is an .example/template file, that it contains only placeholders and no real secret. Report only if something is wrong. Say nothing if the file is correctly placed and clean.
